checklist.criterion: Verify root-supplied source SHA; probe true duration, dimensions, rate and frame count. Direction and request pins must match.

When first exposed the binder page clearly contains existing dark rows, rules and completed marks at final review size. No blank reveal, writing-in-view, materializing print, legible invented facts or later erasure.
checklist.evidence: Exposed pages have empty ruled body rows with a repeated check-mark strip. No visibly written answer at full or1280 review size.

checklist.criterion: One coherent cover opening on a stable spine. Cover and page remain distinct; plausible hinge, contact, occlusion and hand movement. No replacement sheet, paper duplication, binder stretch, teleportation or passing through props.
checklist.evidence: Broad lift/reorientation/open/settle sequence visible in6-frame samples; differs from strict in-place direction. Continuous real-time mechanics not certified.

checklist.criterion: After reveal, owner places one index finger beside a specific populated row. Point is visually identifiable, brief and directed to content; not merely palm resting on the page or aimless gesture.
checklist.evidence: Clear index-finger point is present, but its target row is empty, not a populated answer.

checklist.criterion: Owner withdraws her pointing hand fully clear of the target row and leaves the open binder stable. Buyer follows visually without a hand collision; enough stable tail remains for a B seed and cut.
checklist.evidence: Hand withdraws near180 and is resting clear at192.

checklist.criterion: Same accepted owner left in tan and buyer right in blue with glasses, faces and roles; workshop daylight, table and action line; original loose blank sheet, pencil and keys remain distinct and unchanged. Camera stays fixed.
checklist.evidence: Cast, sides, wardrobe, room and separate loose sheet/pencil/keys recognizable in sampled frames; not full per-frame certification.

checklist.criterion: Prompt opening without hesitation or new speech; buyer attention follows the indicated row. No extra turns, repeated taps, writing, handshake or sale conclusion. A need not supply the positive nod assigned to B.
checklist.evidence: Prompt presentation and attention visible. Source reaction in B not judged from A. No normal-speed speech/mouth or timing audit.

checklist.criterion: Find a continuous unretimed 170-frame interval preserving opening, populated reveal, clear point, withdrawal and settled tail. No loops, freezes or speed change. Revealed content is readable as populated by the selected-slot offset 5.48 seconds, at the latest.
checklist.evidence: No compliant170-frame interval can avoid empty-record defect while retaining required reveal and point.

checklist.criterion: Recommend exact source frame only after a successful reveal and withdrawal, with stable visible populated page, no blur/occlusion, stable identity and coherent geometry. It must match the selected A out state; bind source and extracted seed hashes. No seed can repair failed motion.
checklist.evidence: No seed recommended. Hand-clear finalframe192 retains empty-body-page defect.

source_review_recommendation: FAIL. Do not use Take A for corrected payoff or seed Take B: ruled forms remain empty of body text.
